en: Illustrated view of a narrow cobblestone street lined with tall medieval stone and plaster houses with steep red-tiled roofs. A horse-drawn cart travels along the street. In the background rises a large church tower with a square base and a very tall, slender spire topped by a finial, flanked by small corner pinnacles. A leafy tree stands on the left near a cylindrical advertising column that bears a small poster. The sky is grey and overcast. The style is that of an early-20th‑century color lithograph.
